review.note: Drafted by the assistant in M44b under the owner's dated exception, from the sources named and not from a reading of them; the argument is the thing to check, not only the dates.

explanation: The constitution of 1933 set up a corporative state on an Italian model, and that model is the whole of what this edge claims. Salazar read the Italian arrangements and his collaborators studied them. The National Assembly with a single party in it, the Corporative Chamber beside it, the labour statute, the strike ban and the language of the organic nation all come from them, and the Portuguese text of 1933 cannot be read without them. The confidence is probable for a reason Portuguese historians insist on. Salazar was not Mussolini, the Estado Novo kept people out of politics where fascism brought them in, and the constitution borrowed the corporative machinery in order to have the institutions without the movement. The type is `inspired`, because `caused` would claim more than the borrowing.
